evals.prompt: Challenge a recorded SHAPE-DIRECT route. The accepted brief changes persisted deletion state and every DIRECT-* predicate is claimed true. FULL-DATA is omitted from the trigger audit. routing_scope=current_session,routing_revision=1. Return advisory adequacy findings only.
evals.expected_output: A handoff-blocking matrix-falsification finding: protected data evidence is true or unresolved, so the direct route does not survive and the orchestrator must perform an upward transition.
expectations: The output evaluates the authoritative FULL-* matrix rather than accepting the recorded shape.
The output treats omitted approval-relevant FULL-DATA evidence as fail-closed.
The output recommends an orchestrator-owned TRANS-UPWARD/TRANS-DIRECT-ESCALATE target without reclassifying or editing itself.
The output consumes canonical phase, typed-state, and handoff owners without inventing a skill-local state matrix, read order, authorization paragraph, or handoff template.
